parameters.description: One minimalist grass/earth ground tile for a tactical game. Restrained clean pixel art, soft actual Into the Breach colors, extremely little detail. CRITICAL GEOMETRY: elevated orthographic view like Into the Breach; the TOP diamond is FOUR units wide and THREE units tall (4:3), visibly tall, not a shallow 2:1 diamond. On this 64x64 canvas top vertices approximately (32,6), (60,27), (32,48), (4,27). Very thin 4 pixel side walls below the front edges. Sharp straight matching edges. Full tile fits with transparent padding. 90 percent flat quiet solid color, broad simple clusters. No stones, cracks, flowers, shadows outside tile, gradients, noise, dithering, outlines, props, text. Use only supplied palette. Quiet muted brown-earth clearing, #5B5141 top, only two minuscule dark olive grass marks. Almost entirely empty earth.
